headline: Creative Newtech Limited: Updates
sum: Updates - Creative Newtech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Creative Newtech Limited approves acquisition of 100% stake in Zicom SaaS Private Limited for approximately Rs. 50.50 Crore (Enterprise Value) to strengthen its…
detail: Updates - Creative Newtech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Creative Newtech Limited approves acquisition of 100% stake in Zicom SaaS Private Limited for approximately Rs. 50.50 Crore (Enterprise Value) to strengthen its Surveillance and Managed Security Services Business'.
